title: Azure Event Hubs connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Azure Event Hubs connector instance's settings, read by the native Kafka family (`loams_connector_kafka::kafka`, CN2 Task 9, OR-22) through the namespace's Kafka endpoint under the `azure-event-hubs` target profile. The profile's defaults set `security_protocol: sasl_ssl`, SASL `plain` and the username `$ConnectionString`, so an instance gives `brokers` (<namespace>.servicebus.windows.net:9093), `topics` (the event hub), `group_id` (the Event Hubs consumer group) and `sasl.password`. The keys are the Kafka connector's less the schema registry (R9.8). `sasl.password` and `tls.key_pem` hold the **names** of secrets in the namespace's store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list.

brokers.description: Bootstrap brokers as host:port, comma separated. Required: there is no default cluster.

topics.description: Topics this instance reads or writes. A route narrows the set further (§33 D355, `source` in a route).

group_id_prefix.description: The consumer group, when group_id is not set: without either the group is `loams-<ns>-<instance>`.

group_id.description: The full consumer group id; it wins over group_id_prefix. On Event Hubs this is the Event Hubs consumer group, for example $Default.

enable_idempotence.description: The idempotent producer (enable.idempotence=true with acks=all). It may not be turned off, which is why the manifest declares sink.idempotent: true.

acks.description: The producer's acks setting. all is required with the idempotent producer.

auto_offset_reset.description: Where a group with no committed offset starts. earliest replays the topic; CN1 defaults to latest so a new instance does not ingest history.

security_protocol.description: The transport security. Without sasl_* no sasl block is read; with it the sasl block is required.

sasl.description: SASL material. The profile's defaults give the mechanism (plain) and the username ($ConnectionString), so an instance names only the password secret.

mechanism.description: The SASL mechanism (the manifest's auth slugs sasl-plain, sasl-scram-256, sasl-scram-512). OAUTHBEARER, and with it aws-msk-iam, is not built (R9.6).

password.description: The **name** of the secret holding the SASL password (the namespace's connection string on Event Hubs), resolved through the secret store (D189).

tls.description: TLS material. Present only when security_protocol ends with _ssl or is ssl.

enabled.description: Whether TLS is on at all.

ca_pem.description: The CA bundle that verifies the broker, as PEM.

cert_pem.description: The client certificate for mTLS, as PEM (not a secret).

key_pem.description: The **name** of the secret holding the client private key for mTLS (PEM), resolved through the secret store (D189).

verify_full.description: Whether the broker certificate's hostname is verified.

delivery.description: The sink's delivery. The azure-event-hubs profile narrows sink.transactional (no Kafka transactions on Event Hubs, R0.19), so only effectively_once, the idempotent producer, is accepted; the factory refuses exactly_once.

checkpoint_topic.description: The compacted topic the transactional sink keeps its checkpoint in (key <ns>/<instance>/<split>). Unused on Event Hubs, which has no transactional sink.

create_checkpoint_topic.description: Create checkpoint_topic (compacted, one partition) when it is missing. Unused on Event Hubs, which has no transactional sink.

max_record_bytes.description: The largest record the sink writes (message.max.bytes); a larger event goes to the DLQ as poison.

transaction_timeout_ms.description: transaction.timeout.ms of the transactional producer. Unused on Event Hubs, which has no transactional sink.

recover_timeout_ms.description: How long the transactional sink's recovery may read checkpoint_topic. Unused on Event Hubs, which has no transactional sink.

poll_wait_ms.description: How long the source waits for a first record before it reports nothing.

pipeline.description: The connector SDK's per-instance pipeline overrides (max_batch_rows, max_batch_bytes, linger_ms, max_in_flight_batches, memory_budget_bytes, checkpoint_interval_ms, retry).
